common.adminOnly: This section is for administrators only.

home.title: IoT FENSTER Partner Portal
home.description: B2B order management against a deferred purchase order. Log in with your partner account or register your company to request access.
home.badge: B2B portal for distributors and installers
home.f1Text: Products authorised for your company, with your price list and discount already applied.
home.f2Text: Confirm orders against your purchase order. No online payment: deferred invoicing.
home.f3Text: Order status at every step, a PDF summary and the shipment tracking link.

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Access the IoT FENSTER ordering portal.
login.noAccount: Your company doesn't have access yet?

recuperarPassword.title: Recover password
recuperarPassword.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
recuperarPassword.doneBody: If an account exists with that email, you'll receive a password reset link within a few minutes.

resetearPassword.title: Reset password
resetearPassword.missingToken: Invalid link: reset token is missing.
resetearPassword.doneBody: Your password has been updated successfully. You can now log in.

registro.title: Register your company
registro.doneBody: Check the corporate email address you provided to verify the account. Once verified, an IoT FENSTER administrator will review and approve the registration.

catalogo.title: Authorized catalog
catalogo.empty: Your authorized catalog doesn't have any products yet.

checkout.emptyCart: Your cart is empty, there is nothing to confirm.
checkout.poNumberHelp: Your company's purchase order number, for your internal accounting reference.
checkout.disclaimer: On confirmation, the order is registered with prices frozen. No online payment is taken: it is settled against the purchase order provided.
checkout.pricesChanged: The prices in your cart have changed. We have updated the summary: check the new total and confirm again.

pedidos.title: My orders
pedidos.empty: You haven't confirmed any orders yet.
pedidos.loadError: We couldn't load your orders. Please try again.
pedidos.searchPlaceholder: Search by PED code, PO Number or product…

pedidoDetalle.downloadError: The PDF could not be downloaded. Please try again.
pedidoDetalle.reorderError: The order could not be repeated. Please try again.
pedidoDetalle.reorderDone: {n, plural, one {# product was added to your cart at today''s price.} other {# products were added to your cart at today''s prices.}}
pedidoDetalle.reorderNone: No products could be added to your cart.
pedidoDetalle.reorderUnavailable: No longer available and not added: {productos}.

adminPartners.title: Companies
adminPartners.subtitle: Partners with their own sub-brand and clients who buy under a partner's brand: sign-ups, terms and catalogue.
adminPartners.pendingBanner: {n, plural, one {# partner is waiting for your approval.} other {# partners are waiting for your approval.}}
adminPartners.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, tax ID, domain or code…
adminPartners.genericError: The action could not be completed. Please try again.

done.suspender: {partner} suspended: they cannot sign in or order until you reactivate them.

rechazar.title: Reject {partner}'s request?
rechazar.body: They will not be able to enter the platform. This is final from the panel: a rejected partner cannot be approved again.

suspender.title: Suspend {partner}?
suspender.body: Their users will stop being able to sign in and order immediately. Orders already confirmed are not affected and you can reactivate them at any time.

reactivar.title: Reactivate {partner}?
reactivar.body: Their users will be able to sign in and place orders again.

archivar.title: Archive {partner}?
archivar.body: It will disappear from the lists and its users will not be able to sign in. Its data and orders are kept, and you can unarchive it at any time. A company with unshipped orders cannot be archived.

desarchivar.title: Unarchive {partner}?
desarchivar.body: It will appear in the lists again and, if it was active, its users will be able to sign in again.

adminPartners.approveIntro: Set their commercial terms. As soon as you approve them they can sign in.
adminPartners.approveBrandHint: This brand decides the catalog names and SKUs suggested to them (VBH, Procomsa…).
adminPartners.approveError: Could not approve. Please try again.
adminPartners.approveDoneBody: They can sign in now. The most important step is left: assigning the products they can order.
adminPartners.notFound: This partner could not be found.
adminPartners.incompleteBanner: This partner has provisional data (tax ID, domain or address). Complete it so you can invoice and contact them.
adminPartners.createSubtitle: Register a company that is ready to order: it becomes active right away, with its first user.

comercial.title: Commercial terms
comercial.description: Brand, tariff and discount applied to their orders.

contacto.title: Contact
contacto.description: Phones and emails to reach the partner and send them documents.

envio.title: Shipping address
envio.description: Only if different from the tax address. Suggested when confirming an order.

primerUsuario.title: First access user
primerUsuario.description: The person who will sign in to the portal on the partner's behalf. You can manage their users later.

notas.title: Internal notes
notas.description: Only IoT FENSTER sees them, never the partner.

hints.dominioWeb: Without http:// or www. Example: company.com
hints.marcaComercial: Decides which names and SKUs they see when products are assigned: VBH, Procomsa…
hints.descuentoPorcentaje: Applied to all their products except those with their own discount.
hints.passwordUsuario: At least 8 characters. You give it to the partner.
hints.marcaCatalogo: Names and codes shown in their catalogue. Clients use MySmartWindow by default.

adminPartners.partnersHelp: companies with their own sub-brand of our devices
adminPartners.clientsHelp: distributors and end customers; they see the devices of their assigned brand
adminPartners.archivedBanner: This company is archived: it does not appear in the lists and cannot sign in. Its data and orders are kept.
adminPartners.deleteBody: The company, {usuarios, plural, one {its user} other {its # users}}, its catalog and its carts will be erased. This cannot be undone. It is only possible because it has no orders; if you prefer to keep its data, archive it.

cancelarPedido.reasonPrompt: Enter the cancellation reason (recorded for feedback):

adminCatalogoBase.title: Global product catalog
adminCatalogoBase.description: Every IoT FENSTER device, one per model and color. Tick the ones you want and assign them to one or several partners: each brand's name and SKU are suggested automatically.

adminCatalogoBase.genericError: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
adminCatalogoBase.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, SKU, GTIN or reference…
adminCatalogoBase.removeImageConfirm: Remove the image from {n} product(s)? Partners will see the default icon.
adminCatalogoBase.imageHelp: PNG, JPG or WEBP, max 3 MB. The same photo is used for every brand.
adminCatalogoBase.notAssigned: Not in any partner's catalog yet.
adminCatalogoBase.partnerSpecs: What the partner sees on the product page
adminCatalogoBase.samePriceForAll: Use the same price for all
adminCatalogoBase.morePartners: Showing {shown} of {total}: refine the search to see the rest.
adminCatalogoBase.stepPreview: How it will look for each partner

adminCatalogoBase.needBrand: Choose the brand of every partner highlighted in amber to continue.
adminCatalogoBase.noEquivalent: no name in that brand, not assigned
adminCatalogoBase.needPrices: Enter the RRP of every product to continue.

adminCatalogoBase.skippedNoEquivalent: {n} combination(s) were skipped because the product has no name in the partner's brand. You can assign them by hand from the partner's page.
adminCatalogoBase.confirmDiscard: There are unassigned changes. Close and discard them?

adminPartnerCatalogo.assignedEmpty: This partner doesn't have any assigned products yet.
adminPartnerCatalogo.genericError: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
adminPartnerCatalogo.brandHelp: Assigns every product of the brand at once, with its name, SKU and list-price PVP. Then just remove the exceptions.
adminPartnerCatalogo.brandNothing: There are no new priced products for this brand.
adminPartnerCatalogo.brandNoPrice: {n} products of this brand are skipped because the price list has no price for them yet.
adminPartnerCatalogo.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}” from this partner's catalogue? It will also be removed from their carts. Existing orders are not affected.
adminPartnerCatalogo.deleteAllConfirm: Delete all {n} products from this partner's catalogue? They will also be removed from their carts. Existing orders are not affected.
adminPartnerCatalogo.deleteExtrasConfirm: Delete this company's {n} extra products? They will also be removed from their carts. Brand products and existing orders are not affected.
adminPartnerCatalogo.brandBanner: Sees the {marca} brand catalogue: it updates on its own when the brand changes. Here you can adjust its discount or hide products.
adminPartnerCatalogo.extrasHelp: Assigned by hand to this company only, outside its brand's catalogue. Name, SKU and price are edited here.
adminPartnerCatalogo.addExtraHide: Hide the list of products to add

forzarEstado.title: Manual status correction
forzarEstado.description: Lets you move the order to any status (forward or backward), outside the normal flow. This is recorded in the audit log.
forzarEstado.confirmText: Confirm forcing order {codigo} from {desde} to {hasta}? This is an exceptional action and will be recorded.

adminUsuarios.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate this user? They will not be able to sign in until you activate them again.

adminMarcas.title: Brand catalogues
adminMarcas.description: Each sub-brand has a single catalogue: products, names, SKUs and prices. Every company on that brand (the partner and its clients) sees it right away; each company only adjusts its discount or hides products.
adminMarcas.genericError: Could not save. Please try again.

adminMarcas.removeConfirm: Remove “{name}” from the brand catalogue? It disappears from the catalogue and carts of its {n} companies. Existing orders are not affected.
adminMarcas.namePlaceholder: Name the brand sells it under
adminMarcas.appliesTo: Changes apply right away to the {n} companies on the {marca} brand.
adminMarcas.canAddHelp: They have a name in this brand but are not in its catalogue. Check name, SKU and price and add them.
